turns.content: Normalize the spin-1/2 state proportional to (1+i)|up>+(2-i)|down> in the z-spin basis.
The operator A has off-diagonal entries hbar/2 and zero diagonal entries in that basis. Write its matrix and find its normalized eigenstates and eigenvalues.
Project the normalized state onto the eigenbasis of A and calculate both outcome probabilities exactly and numerically.
Use those probabilities and eigenvalues to calculate the expectation value of A.
Collect the two branch quantities and the mean value in one result, labeling the branches.
Verify the expectation value both by weighting the eigenvalues and by directly evaluating <psi|A|psi> in the original basis.
Explain how the two eigenvalue branches contribute and how the probability imbalance determines the expectation value.
Would rephasing either eigenvector change any observable probability or expectation value?
Report both outcome probabilities and the expectation value of A.
